title: Olivia Rodrigo · drop dead
description: A pastel-pink VHS daydream progressing from a crowded neon dive bar in a pearl-beaded white dress to laptop-glowing Versailles bedchambers, leaping across the Gallery of Battles, sliding down the Queen’s marble staircase, rocking matching hot-pink electric guitars in a gilded Rococo salon, gliding past a white swan at dusk, and collapsing across the floodlit Palace steps. Original instrumental with two physical CHIMERA voices.
